summary: Off-registry unpinned git dependency enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares a dependency `test-supply-npm-git-prepare-proof-4` sourced from `git+https://github.com/agustedone/test-supply-npm-git-prepare-proof-4.git` with no commit SHA or tag pin. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever the referenced GitHub repo currently returns and executes any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) inside that clone with no version pin, hash, or integrity check. The shipped index.js is an inert stub, so the manifest line itself is the entire delivery mechanism: whoever controls the referenced repository controls code that runs on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
